## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- SubscriptionStore -- plan resolution
- returns free for unknown / empty userId (fail safe)
- returns the set plan after setPlan, and persists across instances
- falls back to free entitlements for canceled / past_due
- grants entitlements ONLY for active/trialing; every other status -> free (allowlist)
- throws on an unknown plan (fail loud, no silent downgrade)
